title: WAF blocking real customers
scenario: "After switching WAF to Prevention, customers get 403 and 429 during the campaign." — Support (GD-09)
mission: Move WAF from Detection to Prevention safely, reproduce a false positive with an aggressive rate limit, and tune it from evidence.
objectives: Tune rate limits from traffic percentiles

steps.title: Probe in Detection
steps.detail: SQL injection probe returns 200 but is logged.

steps.title: False positive
steps.detail: Lower waf_rate_limit_per_minute to 10, browse, read the logs, tune.

criteria.text: An injection probe is blocked (403) in Prevention
The rate limit is back above the observed p99 per client
WAF log query returns the blocked requests

expectedResult: A WAF that blocks attacks, not customers.
recovery: Locked out yourself? Raise the limit through Terraform; never disable the WAF policy.
dont: Do not disable managed rules globally
hints: Detection logs what Prevention would block.
RateLimitPerClient appears in the WAF logs.

interview.question: Why roll out a WAF in Detection first, and how do you tune it?

debrief: Detection gives a baseline of what would be blocked; Prevention after tuning. Rate limits come from real traffic percentiles, not guesses.

checker.plan: Read-only: HTTP probe through Front Door, Log Analytics query, terraform output of waf settings.

validation.notes: Checker not implemented yet; needs the edge layer.
